game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: MadPixelYoutube
quote: The game offers absolutely no innovation; it features the same gameplay as GTA 5, just with better graphics. The gunplay is generic. The characters lack charisma, making it impossible to empathize with them. Not to mention all the obvious complaints from the community pointing out the clear progressive agenda the game seeks to push. A major disappointment.
